Hi Fam Team,

I hope you're doing well. 

My name is Amod Jadhav. I came across your contact while researching holiday homes/short-term rental companies in Dubai. I have over 4 years of experience in hospitality operations and property management, currently managing 26 units across 3 properties in Bengaluru, India — handling OTA management (Booking.com, Airbnb, Agoda), pricing, and guest experience.

I'm exploring opportunities in Dubai and wanted to check if there are any openings for an Operations Coordinator or similar role at your company. If you're not the right person for this, I'd really appreciate it if you could point me to the right contact.

Thank you so much for your time!
